module_name: Short-Video Analytics: Watch Time, Completion, Saves, Hooks, Retention Curves
module_description: Module 23 is the platform-mode module for the 2026 content default: TikTok/Reels/Shorts. It teaches the metrics that matter (watch time and completion rate, shares/saves/comments quality, retention curves, hooks in first 1-3 seconds), how ranking algorithms amplify these, and how to analyze them. Students analyze retention curves and hook structures of a set of short videos.
core_concepts: Short-video ranking signals (watch time, completion, saves)
learning_outcomes: C3 Extract and interpret retention and engagement metrics for short videos
C4 Compare video performance with audience-normalized metrics
C5 Translate video metrics into strategy recommendations
methods_models: Retention-curve feature extraction, hook classification (manual + model), engagement-rate normalization, regression on video features
evaluation_metrics: Completion rate, average watch time, engagement-per-follower, correlation of features with retention, confidence intervals on small samples
pitfalls_limitations: Metrics not comparable across creators without normalization, autoplay bias, sampling of only successful videos, engagement ≠ quality or truth
tools_stack: yt-dlp for media, ffmpeg for frames, pandas, Whisper for audio, CLIP for frames, TikTok/YouTube analytics definitions
commercial_platforms: Native creator analytics demos (TikTok Creator Marketplace, YouTube Studio)
tools_access_cost: Media processing is free; native analytics need creator accounts
lab_activities: Analyze 30 short videos: retention curves, hook patterns, and which features predict completion
datasets_apis: Short-video sample with public metrics and downloadable media
assessment_methods: Lab submission plus a short strategy recommendation memo; graded on metric validity and quality of reasoning
data_collection_workflow: Collect short-video metadata and media -> transcribe/OCR -> extract retention and engagement features -> normalise by follower base -> analyse and report
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: TikTok overtook Instagram in several markets; short video became the default unit of social content, so SMA curricula must center video metrics, not just text
industry_relevance: Directly used in short-form content strategy, creator-marketing measurement, and social-commerce analytics teams; the metrics in this module (watch time, completion, saves, CTR via video) are the same KPIs agencies report to clients.
localization_context: Taught against the Indonesian short-video and live-commerce ecosystem (TikTok Shop, live shopping sessions, Shopee/Tokopedia live), which has different content formats and monetization mechanics from the US market.
ethics_regulation: Disclosure of paid partnerships, sponsored content and affiliate links; UU PDP and platform rules on scraping engagement data; caution when profiling creators and audiences from public metrics.
case_study_scenarios: Compare two local creators' retention patterns and recommend content changes.
deliverable_format: Video analytics dataset + retention figures + recommendations memo
